items.html: *And this is what is written: “Come and see, the head, the beginning of faith,” etc., “the spark of the flint struck” — which is the root of judgment concealed in the innards of Ima, as mentioned in the Idra Zuta — “and cast sparks to 320 directions.” For these kings, being judgments and harsh Gevurot, are called sparks of fire that came out from the Botzina de-Kardinuta. And their number was 320 sparks, each spark distinct from its fellow, “every one straight forward.” And their casting was such that they descended below the world of Atzilut. And while they were there, “the waste was clarified from within the thought, and was clarified.” For since they were harsh judgments, the waste of the shell was mingled in them; and when they were cast below, they were clarified and corrected. And the good and the holy in them returned to be corrected by means of the eighth king, who is called Hadar, and rose upward; and from the waste in them the discernments of the shells were made, and they remained below.
